visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A wide shot establishes an empty indoor event hall filled with rows of black folding chairs on a gray floor under an industrial white ceiling with visible ventilation. (2) A woman in a black long-sleeved shirt and beige trousers walks steadily down the central aisle toward the back of the room. (3) The scene shifts to a pink wall decorated with many small red chili icons; a woman wearing a beige oversized hoodie, a red scarf, and a red cap points her finger at a large graphic of a smiling red chili pepper wearing sunglasses. (4) A close-up shows a hand holding a speech bubble-shaped sign with the text '葳老闆的辣雞湯' and a chili logo, placing it on top of a black gift bag resting on a chair. (5) Multiple rows of black chairs are visible, each carrying a paper gift bag with the same '葳' branding. (6) A woman dressed in all black with a black baseball cap performs or poses on a small pink circular stage located in the corner of the studio space. (7) A white banner with pink text reads 'MAYUKI CHOU 1ST FAN MEETING (IN TAIPEI)'. (8) A black pedestal displays several rows of small clear water bottles with pink labels and chili graphics. (9) A person's hand holds four red photo cards labeled 'MAYUKI CHOU' and '12 JAN 2025'. (10) A close-up of a wall with pink and white sticky notes; one note prominently displays 'No. 456' in black marker. (11) A final wide panning shot shows the empty hall from a different angle, revealing the scale of the empty seating arrangement.
